faqs.q: How much does siding installation cost in Baton Rouge?
faqs.a: Siding installation in Baton Rouge typically ranges from $6,000 to $20,000 for a full home. Vinyl siding averages $7–$12 per sq ft installed. Fiber cement (HardiePlank) runs $10–$18 per sq ft. We provide free in-home estimates.

faqs.q: What siding material is best for Louisiana's climate?
faqs.a: Fiber cement siding (HardiePlank) is our top recommendation for Baton Rouge — it resists humidity, termites, and hurricane-force winds. High-quality vinyl is a cost-effective alternative. Avoid wood siding in Louisiana's wet climate.

faqs.q: Do you offer storm damage siding repair?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle insurance claims for storm and hail damage. Louisiana homeowners policies often cover storm-damaged siding. We document damage, work with adjusters, and handle all repairs.

faqs.q: Do you serve Gonzales, Prairieville, and Zachary?
faqs.a: Yes — we serve all of East Baton Rouge Parish and surrounding areas including Gonzales, Prairieville, Zachary, Baker, Port Allen, Walker, and Denham Springs.

faqs.q: How long does a full siding replacement take?
faqs.a: Most full home siding replacements take 3–7 days depending on home size and siding material. We handle all tear-off, installation, trim, and cleanup.
